text: All students except EU/EFTA state members require a visa to enter Switzerland. After your application is accepted, the Office of Admissions will send you all the information and required documents to submit to the Consul

title: How long does the visa application take?
text: Please remember that the visa application process may take up to 3 months depending on the time of the year and the review procedure at your embassy or consulate. Plan accordingly.

title: How do I get my Swiss residence permit?
text: Once you arrive in Switzerland, the Administration team will inform you about how to apply for your Swiss residence permit, which you can use to travel across Switzerland and the Schengen Area.

title: Can HBS help me with the visa documentation?
text: We can help provide the necessary documentation that can support your visa application. However, you will need to make an appointment and inquire about any other specific visa requirements with the embassy or consulate.

title: Where do I apply for the visa?
text: You will need to contact the embassy or consulate of Switzerland in your country, which you can find online. You can also contact us, and we will help you with any questions you may have.

title: Can HBS accelerate my visa?
text: Please note that we cannot influence or accelerate the process as it is independently processed by the Secretariat of Migration.

title: What happens if my visa application is rejected?
text: In the case of a rejected visa application, you can still appeal the decision. You should contact the HBS team to guide you through the process.

title: Are there visa fees?
text: You will need to contact the embassy or consulate in your country to inquire about any required fees.

title: Can I work while studying in Switzerland?
text: Foreign students can work up to 15 hours per week during their studies. However, students who are not from the EU/EFTA will need to wait 6 months after commencing their studies before they are allowed to work.

title: How long can I stay in Switzerland?
text: The exact date up to which you can stay in Switzerland will be set by the immigration authorities and will be outlined in your visa. You are not allowed to stay in Switzerland past that date.

title: When should I arrive in Switzerland?
text: Ideally, you should arrive at least 1 week before the start of the term in order to accustom yourself and complete your registration process.

title: Which airport should I fly into?
text: The nearest airport is Geneva airport, which is around an 80–85 minute train ride away. You will find trains directly to the region; depending on when you arrive, you might need to take a connecting train from Lausanne.

title: How do I reach the campus?
text: HBS is located at Chemin du Levant 5, 1814 La Tour-de-Peilz. The nearest regional train connections run along the Lake Geneva line between Lausanne and Montreux, which you can use to reach Lausanne, Montreux and Geneva.
